_note: The statements a syllabus is required to carry. Every college has its own list and its own wording, so this is data rather than code: edit it, or point syllabus_policies_path in config.json at your own copy. `any` is a list of regular expressions, matched case-insensitively against the syllabus text with the markup stripped. One match is enough.
_source: Defaults drawn from what is commonly required at a US community college: ADA/504, academic integrity, attendance, Title IX. Check them against your own catalogue before relying on this for a report.

policies.label: Disability services (ADA / Section 504)
policies.why: Students cannot request an accommodation they are never told exists. This is the statement most often audited.

policies.label: Academic integrity
policies.why: A penalty for cheating is hard to sustain if the syllabus never set the expectation.

policies.label: Attendance
policies.why: Attendance drives financial aid reporting and last-date-of-attendance calculations.

policies.label: Title IX / sexual harassment
policies.why: Instructors are usually mandatory reporters, and the syllabus is where students are told that.

policies.label: Grading scale
policies.why: A grade appeal starts with what the syllabus said the scale was. Matched on a scale, a weighting or a grading section, not on the word 'grade' alone -- which appears in every syllabus ever written and would make this check always pass.

policies.label: Instructor contact and office hours
policies.why: Required almost everywhere, and the first thing a student looks for.
